## Document 4: Recruitment Script

::: {.definition-box}
**What it is:** A short script for approaching potential participants and inviting them to take part.

**Tips:** Brief and friendly (3–4 sentences). Mention: who you are, what the study involves (briefly), how long it takes, where to go, any incentive (e.g. snacks). Print several copies so multiple people can recruit at once.
:::

---

## Document 5: Data Recording Sheet

::: {.definition-box}
**What it is:** A table where you record each participant's data (condition, DV score, optional demographics).

**Tips:** Columns for participant number, condition (if between-subjects), DV score, optional demographics. Include a **scoring guide** so all group members score consistently. Delete the between- or within-subjects table you don't need from the template. Accuracy matters — this is your raw data.
:::

---

## Document 6: Stimulus Materials

::: {.definition-box}
**What it is:** The actual materials participants see or use — word lists, images, passages, rating sheets, questionnaires.

**Tips:** Match materials across conditions (e.g. word frequency, difficulty, length). Use the [Project Options](../../project/group-project-options.qmd) and worked example in the toolkit. Test on each other before data collection day.
:::

---

## Document 8: Complete Researcher Procedure

::: {.definition-box}
**Finish** what you started in Phase 1:
- Full step-by-step with **exact wording** (in quotes)
- **Timing** for every phase
- **Data recording**: when and how you fill in the Data Recording Sheet
- **Scoring**: how you score the DV (reference to scoring guide)
- **Checklist** of materials to prepare before each session

Any group member should be able to run the study from this document alone.
:::

---

## Practice Run

::: {.exercise-box}
**In your group (20–30 min):**

1. One person plays **researcher**, others play **participants**.
2. Run through the full procedure: consent → instructions → task → debrief.
3. Use a **timer**; record "data" on your Data Recording Sheet.
4. Note: What was unclear? What took too long or too little time? Did the instructions make sense?
5. **Swap** so someone else runs it; repeat if time.
6. Update the Researcher Procedure and Participant Instructions with any fixes.
:::

---

## Document 9: Research Study Order Form

::: {.definition-box}
**What it is:** A form listing everything your group needs **printed or provided** for data collection day. You submit this to Gordon so resources can be prepared in advance.

**When:** Submit by **end of this week** at latest (Week 19 lab is data collection).

**Tips:** List every document and how many copies (err on the side of more). Include special requirements (e.g. colour printing, specific paper). Don't forget consumables: pens, blank paper, snacks.
:::
